name: Connected
source: You never knew your "real" family. As a baby you were placed in foster care along with your twin sister, Charlotte, and ended up being separated as a result. 19 years later and you are reached out to by your birth mother, who has given up on her fight with cancer and you reunite with her as well as your twin sister. The 3 of you begin to make up for lost time, but can you build a familial relationship with your sister after all this time? Or will other feelings complicate this.
translation: 你永远不了解你“真正的”家庭。当你还是个婴儿的时候，你和你的双胞胎妹妹夏洛特一起被安置在寄养家庭，最终却被分开了。19年后，你的亲生母亲找到了你，她已经放弃了与癌症的斗争，你与她以及你的双胞胎姐妹团聚。你们三个开始弥补失去的时间，但经过这么长时间，你能和你的妹妹建立起家庭关系吗？或者其他感觉会让这件事变得复杂吗？
